title: Russian Vermicelli Pilaf
description: A classic Russian dish made with vermicelli, vegetables, and spices. This pilaf is a hearty and flavorful meal option.
instructions: Heat butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add diced onion and sauté until softened.
Add diced carrot and sauté for another 5 minutes.
Add vermicelli, pilaf, salt, and black pepper. Stir well.
Add water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until vermicelli is cooked.
Stir in fresh dill and serve hot.
